column2: [intro]
Today, I’ve got a great idea in mind,
I want to make music, the perfect kind.
A catchy beat, and lyrics that amuse,
I want to make everyone groove to my tunes.
I want to be the star of the day,
With a song that makes time sway.
Everyone will swing under the spotlight,
We’ll have a blast, it’s my only wish tonight.
I’ve got my mic, my shades in place,
I’m ready to perform, I’ll light up the space.
I’ll stomp my feet, I’ll sing out loud,
I promise you, this party will make you proud.
When I hit the stage, I’m unstoppable,
Turning into an icon, it’s incredible.
People laugh, dance, and sing along,
I’m their superstar, their number one, their song.
[solo]
I want to be the star of the day,
With a song that makes time sway.
Everyone will swing under the spotlight,
We’ll have a blast, it’s my only wish tonight.
[outro]
